crossRefs.note: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
“I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who…
Have you forgotten Yahweh your Maker, who stretched out the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth? Do you live…
“Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I…
But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell…
But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge…
Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are…
Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t…
“I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on…

people.name: Gabbatha
people.line: Raised stone platform in Jerusalem; location of Jesus' trial

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
translations.bsb: When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat on the judgment seat at a place called the Stone Pavement, which in Hebrew is Gabbatha.
translations.kjv: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
translations.asv: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment-seat at a place called The Pavement, but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.
